name: wos-documentation
description: Workflow OS documentation standard for route-based drafting, reviewing, and publishing to assigned Confluence spaces and templates.

interface.shortDescription: 📚 v0.1.13 - HK routing and simpler intake
interface.longDescription: Workflow OS Documentation standardizes how Help Desk, Infrastructure, DEV/DBA, and Athens employee-facing documentation is drafted, refreshed, reviewed, placed, and published in HelpDesk Knowledge and assigned team Confluence spaces. It applies route-specific or built-in templates with defined section emojis, Infrastructure KB article type selection, DEV/DBA ownership recording while its document-type model is pending team confirmation, KB Refresh, conservative long-source handling, strict question gates for missing intake details, optional visual-asset workflows, and a target-space duplicate or similar-KB preflight with comparison, user choice, and a required Related to header slug.
